summary: Land acquisition dispute; agreement to return half acquired land void ab initio; Board lacked authority to dispose acquired land without LG sanction; Section 24(2) Delhi Agricultural Produce Marketing Act, 1998 prohibits transfer without Lieutenant Governor approval; arbitration award set aside as against public policy; land acquisition cannot be undone by private agreement; Award under Land Acquisition Act, 1894 binding; appeal allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: Delhi Agricultural Produce Marketing Act, 1998 s.24(2)
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 s.34, s.37
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Arbitration Award set aside; Board not bound to execute conveyance; land remains with Board.
